about.label: About Ramichai
about.title: A photographer and videographer building a visual portfolio one strong piece at a time.
about.note: The style is cinematic, but the communication stays simple.
paragraphs: I am Ramichai, a photographer and videographer sharing work across video, photography, events, portraits, personal visuals and social-ready edits.
The portfolio is personal, clean and visual first. It shows the eye behind the camera without turning into a long generic studio page.
The work comes through in reels, photo sets and short notes that explain the feeling behind each project.

contact.title: The portfolio points people straight to the real place: Instagram.
contact.text: No fake form, no random email. Just Ramichai, the work, and @itsamrom as the main contact path.
